resolution_notes: example: both verifiers correct that summoner-by-name is gone — use account-v1 by-riot-id or summoner by-puuid; free_tier_limits/rate_limits: keep original sense but hedge numbers as app-specific (portal) rather than hard-coded.
free_tier_limits: Personal development keys: free with short-term expiration (typically 24h renewal) and low rate limits; production keys free after application approval with higher limits. Exact rate numbers are app-specific and shown in the developer portal.
rate_limits: Personal keys typically have app-specific limits shown in the developer portal (commonly ~20 req/1s and ~100 req/2min historically, but not guaranteed); production apps get higher limits after approval.
